protocol.metric: Sum of actual generated token counts over the four seeds divided by the sum of synchronized engine.generate wall times of the corresponding microbatches. Includes prefill, drafting, verification, scheduling, sampling and output text decoding. Pretokenized inputs, startup and HTTP excluded.
protocol.pairing: Fixed and dynamic use the same 64 prompts, request order, sampler settings, seed, physical GPU, and eight-core CPU affinity in each pair. GPU 0 runs fixed then dynamic, GPU 2 the reverse. No profiling hooks, fresh scheduler and prefix cache per run; seeded draws can change across arms.
protocol.fixed: Up to 4 proposals, subject to request, remaining KV capacity and batch budget. GPU 0 uses frozen pre-edit source; GPU 2 uses the new fixed switch.
protocol.dynamic: After a full draft window is generated, rank 0 uses the per-row max of the temperature-adjusted draft distribution, prefix products and a prefix-only heap. Admit one position if expected committed tokens per estimated target forward time increases. Time model T(R)=intercept+R*slope from two startup CUDA-event measurements. No trained or calibrated confidence head.
protocol.diagnostics: Separate instrumented replay of 64 requests per cell. Qwen3-8B seed 4701 on GPU 0, Qwen3-32B seed 4702 on GPU 2. Dynamic reuses the cost pair from the matching timed engine. avg sent includes rows with 0 drafts. same_round_uncut_graph_rows uses that round's generated candidates before trimming; cross-arm rounds and outputs can differ.
protocol.warmup: 32 disjoint prompts; each engine warms batches 1/8/32 on max(4,batch) prompts capped at 40 prior to measurements. Any first compilation or newly captured target graph during a trial is excluded and that cell repeated.
